body:
Rule (stage 2/3 briefs): bear and seal nap in their own home (den, pond) instead of beside you.
- Bear walks into the cave den, curls up.
- Seal slides to the pond edge, lies down.

comments.text:
Done: bear walks into its den and curls up; seal naps by its pond.
Check the picture: Yes or Change.

short: Bear naps in its cave, seal at its pond. OK?
source: Model movements 31 Oct: gap check against the stage briefs
title: Bear naps in its cave, seal at its pond
